title: Slushie Bar Salts Lemon Lime 10ml E-Liquid
description: Lemon Lime by Slushie Bar Salts is a zesty and invigorating e-liquid that perfectly captures the essence of two classic citrus fruits. This Nic Salt blend offers a refreshing and tangy experience, reminiscent of sipping on a homemade lemon-lime drink on a warm summer’s day. From the first inhale, the sharp and tangy flavour of Lemon bursts onto your tastebuds, offering a bright and refreshing taste. This is beautifully complemented by the slightly sweeter and equally tangy notes of Lime, creating a harmonious and thirst-quenching blend. The interplay between Lemon and Lime provides a perfect balance of tartness and sweetness, making it an ideal all-day vape for those who appreciate a citrus kick. This premium e-liquid’s 50VG/50PG blend hits the sweet spot between flavour and cloud production and the unique nicotine salt solution makes it ideal for use in classic e-cigarette starter kits and pod devices. Perfect for recent ex-smokers or vapers seeking the immediate, satisfying nicotine relief provided by nic salts. If you enjoy this flavour, there are plenty more Slushie Bar Salts flavours to try. Few e-liquid makers have mastered the icy joys of slushy flavours quite like Slushie, a UK company who are behind an irresistible line of 50ml and 100ml shortfill and Nic Salts e-liquids that blend mouth-watering fruit flavours with healthy doses of icy menthol for an unparalleled slushy vaping experience. We’re also thrilled to stock Slushy Bar Salts: Nic Salt e-liquids that capture the intense flavour and satisfaction of your favourite disposable vape flavours in handy 10ml bottles for use with a wide variety of MTL (mouth-to-lung) vape kits.
